ratings_why.fun: Every recruit phase is a real river puzzle (who sits at the Source, who waits at B1, who catches the Gift), and the Bailiff, Jack, Second-Run Hen and Mother Redd chain into Spawn combos the builds don't fully list.
ratings_why.distinct: Earns 8 over 7 because units physically climb the board mid-fight and swap rows, so position changes during combat, which no current tribe or typical auto-battler tribe does; the stay-on-the-road versus go-home tension is its own.

verdict_why: v2 cleared the readability problems; what's left is tuning and small ideas, so another pass would make it different rather than better.

points.text: Selling The Bailiff of the Weir is an on-demand Spawn that fires Little Jack Gravel, Second-Run Hen and Pebble-Carrying Hen during recruiting; worth naming as a build, since it turns a T2 heron into the tribe's combo trigger.
Reunion Cock plus Silver Smolt is a lovely tuning puzzle: Smolt's Stamp can join a fish to the year-class or knock it out. A second card that removes or moves Stamps would make this choice richer.
Pebble-Carrying Hen is still mostly a quiet rider; letting the kept Alevin take its parent's slot with the parent's permanent buffs too would make it a real Long Road bridge.
Units that leap mid-cycle will need a stated rule for whether they attack again in their new reading-order slot that cycle; Captain Kype and Falls-Leaper both lean on it.
The Salmon of Llyn Llyw stacks with Alevin's own per-Stamp bonus, so stamped Alevins become surprise carries; a nice off-label use worth keeping.

standouts.why: No Leap blocker, stamper and sell-to-Spawn outlet in one T2 card; it serves all three builds.
Old Kelt's drift turns one empty slot into a whole-run cascade and a guaranteed homecoming; a real board-slot trade-off.
Mother Redd flips the tribe's cost, so Bailiff sales, Warden homecomings and Jack all become Alevin engines.

weakest.why: Pebble-Carrying Hen only matters on Spawns you'd already make and adds little.
Sea Trout Ferrywife gives no stats and only matters with off-tribe units; easy to skip.
The Faroes Bore is a random +X per turn, the most one-job card in the tribe.

flags.note: With the Warden, Jack and Bailiff sales, Mother Redd could make a golden Alevin and a Discover almost every turn.
Warden plus Second-Run Hen plus Old Kelt cascades could give several doubled Spawns a turn plus +1/+1 to all per homecoming.
Old Kelt is all or nothing on one empty slot; check whether that slot is too cheap a price.
